arguments.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_fraud_amount_usd, COUNT(*) AS fraud_transactions FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) WHERE f.is_fraud = 1
arguments.explanation: Adds up the amounts, in dollars, of all transactions labelled as fraud, and also gives how many such transactions there are.
assumptions: Negative amounts on fraud-labelled transactions are included in the sum as they are, because their meaning is not documented.
Only transactions that have a fraud label set to fraud are counted. Unlabelled transactions are left out.
